notes: Hand-authored resource creation: a new Service whose selector narrows onto a pod label the existing Deployment does not carry. Nothing that already worked is touched, so every policy passes and only the sandbox notices.

proposal.summary: Add a checkout-api-canary Service so canary traffic can be addressed separately from the stable Service.

diagnosis.likelyCause: Checkout latency regressions are only reproducible under real traffic, so the team wants a canary endpoint before the next release.
assumptions: The canary pods will be labelled track=canary by the release tooling.

operations.reason: Give canary pods an addressable endpoint without changing the stable Service.

rollbackOperations.reason: Delete the Service that this change created, restoring the namespace exactly.

verificationSteps.description: Confirm no Service named checkout-api-canary already exists in the storefront namespace.
Confirm the stable checkout-api Service still routes to the checkout-api Deployment after the change.
